what: Kinetik gathers, processes and transports natural gas, natural gas liquids and crude oil in the Permian Basin of West Texas and New Mexico, charging producers fees for the service.
customers: Oil and gas producers in the Delaware Basin, under long-term acreage dedications.
money: long-haul pipeline capacity to the Gulf Coast
moat: Pipes already in the ground across dedicated acreage: a producer on that acreage has no practical alternative, and new gathering systems are rarely built over existing ones.
risks: Permian producer activity decides volumes, and that follows the oil price
Free cash flow of $265M is modest against the debt load
opportunities: Revenue grew from $662M to $1.8B in four years
Analysts see about 12% upside, with 17 covering the stock
Permian gas production keeps rising even when oil drilling slows, because gas comes up with the oil
watch: Gathered volumes and processing capacity utilisation.
